_meta.batch: Examine - lokacja ControlRoom/Centrala Dowodzenia (139 terminow, ~24 mikroscen) - mostek/sterownia lodzi podwodnej. Zawiera mechanike kompasu (Present a Clue), sceny z zazdrosnie strzegacym plaszczem kapitanskim (Sinthia) i tajemniczym przelacznikiem, oraz interakcje z panelem sterowania (dzwignie, radar, glebokosciomierz, predkosciomierz).
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json NIE POKRYWA kategorii Examine. Mowcy przypisani na podstawie kontekstu/tresci. Sinthia rozpoznana jako mowca w scenach CaptainsJacket 1 i jacketswitch (protektorka plaszcza/przelacznika kapitanskiego, zgodnie z jej rola kapitana lodzi ustalona we wczesniejszych batchach).

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_BG/Section.en: Ah, well, you know, it's uh... [mumbling]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_BG/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_BG/Section.en: Should we be calling this the control room... or - [i]the bridge?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_BG/Section.pl: Czy powinniśmy nazywać to centralą dowodzenia... czy - [i]mostkiem?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_BG/Section.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: Don't touch that please! It's behind glass for a [i]reason...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: Proszę tego nie dotykać! Jest za szkłem nie bez [i]powodu...[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: It is a garment of [h]great[/h] historical significance - and must be preserved.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: To strój o [h]wielkim[/h] znaczeniu historycznym - i musi być zachowany.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en:
What... if we just look at it?
From a distance?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl:
A co... jeśli po prostu na to popatrzymy?
Z daleka?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: There's an electronic panel over here... some kind of switch, maybe?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: Jest tu jakiś elektroniczny panel... może jakiś przełącznik?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: Now Sinthia's not here, we could finally take a closer look at that jacket...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: Skoro Sinthii tu nie ma, moglibyśmy wreszcie przyjrzeć się bliżej temu płaszczowi...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: We could, but it's still locked behind glass.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: Moglibyśmy, ale wciąż jest zamknięty za szkłem.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: There must be [h]some[/h] way to get at it.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: Musi być [h]jakiś[/h] sposób, żeby się do niego dostać.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: Oh - hey - there's something bulky in here.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: Och - hej - jest tu coś nieporęcznego.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: It's just like that one we found in the captain's cabin...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: Zupełnie jak to, które znaleźliśmy w kajucie kapitańskiej...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: I've been dying to check in the pockets of this thing...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: Umierałam z chęci, żeby sprawdzić kieszenie tej rzeczy...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.en: It's the Captain's Jacket. We found a radio in the pocket.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.pl: To Płaszcz Kapitana. Znaleźliśmy radio w kieszeni.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_CaptainsJa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: Uh, if we carefully and sensibly interact with this precision equipment.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Yy, jeśli będziemy ostrożnie i rozsądnie obchodzić się z tym precyzyjnym sprzętem.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: Something's [h]bound[/h] to happen if we mess arou-
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Coś [h]na pewno[/h] się stanie, jeśli będziemy tu maj-
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: To coś w rodzaju przebiegu fali.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: I think this is for listening to the ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Chyba to służy do nasłuchiwania oceanu.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: What are they expecting to hear...?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: Yeah. It's mostly a bunch of measurements and readings.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Tak. To głównie stos pomiarów i odczytów.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: Not a whole lot of actual controls...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Nie ma tu zbyt wielu prawdziwych sterowników...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Wygląda na to, że czegoś tu brakuje.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en:
Grimoire.
If [h]you[/h] had a depth meter...
It would say zero.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl:
Grimoire.
Gdybyś [h]ty[/h] miał głębokościomierz...
Pokazywałby zero.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en:
It's a depth meter.
Shows how deep we are.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl:
To głębokościomierz.
Pokazuje, jak głęboko jesteśmy.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: These look like the dials on my oven.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Te wyglądają jak pokrętła w moim piekarniku.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: It's got a bunch of numbers printed on it.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: Oh. I guess it shows the daily readings for the depth, the spedometer and the heading.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Och. Chyba pokazuje dzienne odczyty głębokości, prędkości i kursu.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: I wonder why you'd need that.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Zastanawiam się, po co by to było potrzebne.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: A sheet of glossy paper came out.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: I think this is how they print out stuff they see with the radar machine...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Chyba w ten sposób drukują to, co widzą za pomocą radaru...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en:
So... is there anything on it?
Did it see anything?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl:
Więc... czy coś na nim jest?
Coś to zobaczyło?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en:
A radar?
Maybe some kind of underwater imaging system?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl:
Radar?
Może jakiś system obrazowania podwodnego?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: Either way, it's a machine that looks out into the ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.pl: Tak czy inaczej, to maszyna, która spogląda w głąb oceanu.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.en: I think this one's a spedometer.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_ControlPan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.en: We don't know which way North is...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.pl: Nie wiemy, w którą stronę jest północ...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.speaker: Grimoire (domniemany)

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.en: And, uh - Silkwirm would be [i]which[/i] way?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.pl: I, yy - Silkwirm byłby w [i]którą[/i] stronę?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.en: Let's just... head back to Silkwirm, shall we? Get everyone off this submarine.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.pl: Po prostu... wróćmy do Silkwirm, dobrze? Zabierzmy wszystkich z tej łodzi podwodnej.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.en: We got [i]moved[/i], I - I don't know where we are...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.pl: Zostaliśmy [i]przesunięci[/i], ja - nie wiem, gdzie jesteśmy...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.en: I don't know where - I don't know which way [i]North[/i] is.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.pl: Nie wiem gdzie - nie wiem, w którą stronę jest [i]północ[/i].
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_FixedCompa.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_Window/Sec.en: You can see out into the ocean.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_Window/Sec.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_blueprint/.en: Currently being [h]used[/h] for arts and crafts.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_blueprint/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_blueprint/.en: There's even an arts and crafts table-
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_blueprint/.pl: Jest nawet stół do prac plastycznych-
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_blueprint/.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_chaircontr.en:
That's not a label.
It's a whole [h]document...[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_chaircontr.pl:
To nie jest etykieta.
To cały [h]dokument...[/h]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_chaircontr.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_chaircontr.en: There's a label taped to the back - maybe it [h]says[/h] what kind of chair it is.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_chaircontr.pl: Z tyłu przyklejona jest etykieta - może [h]mówi[/h], jaki to rodzaj fotela.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_chaircontr.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_controlpan.en: I will make no such promise.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_controlpan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_controlpan.en: Can we look at the control panel?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_controlpan.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_controlpan.en: If you promise not to press any of the buttons.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_controlpan.pl: Jeśli obiecasz, że nie naciśniesz żadnego z przycisków.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_controlpan.speaker: Sinthia

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_jacketswit.en: [i]So she basically just confirmed it does something, right?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_jacketswit.pl: [i]Czyli w zasadzie właśnie potwierdziła, że to coś robi, prawda?[/i]
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_jacketswit.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_mural/Sect.en: Hey, there's a mosaic on the wall here.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_mural/Sect.pl: Hej, tu na ścianie jest mozaika.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_mural/Sect.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_platform/S.en: There's a whole raised dais here...
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_platform/S.speaker: Grimoire

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_platform/S.en: What's that symbol in the middle of the floor? An eight?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_platform/S.pl: Co to za symbol na środku podłogi? Ósemka?
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_platform/S.speaker: Sally

Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_wires/Sect.en: Careful not to trip on those wires.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_wires/Sect.pl: Uważaj, żeby nie potknąć się o te kable.
Examine/Exam_Area_ControlRoom_wires/Sect.speaker: Grimoire
